instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must enforce per-source packet quota in BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'client_quota_map' dropping after 100 packets. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'client_quota_map' with key __u32 and value __u64
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Lookup ip->saddr in client_quota_map and atomically increment count
Drop packet with XDP_DROP if packet count exceeds 100
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
